notes.title: Studio Namaapa's New Game in development, Ciel Fledge is now live on Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10715969/0a8cfa4609155f23f483ae7001e82f26180ec1b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ciel Fledge is on Kickstarter[/h1]

Our new game is now live on Kickstarter. If you are interested to support us, feel free to do so by visiting the link below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1275858615/ciel-fledge]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1275858615/ciel-fledge[/url]

Ciel Fledge is a raising simulation game where the objective is to raise your adopted daughter in the span of 10 years. During those 10 years she will grow into an adult, under your care and guidance. How you decide to parent her is up to you. Every decision matters.

If you are familiar with raising sim game classics such as 'Princess Maker 2' and the more recent 'Long Live The Queen' you will feel right at home with this game.

For those who are new to the raising sim genre, you can compare the game to the popular 'The Sims' series, except in Ciel Fledge, you are managing and raising one person, your adopted daughter.

[h1]State of the game[/h1]

We've been working on this game for about one and a half years, with most of the development costs coming from our own pocket. Unfortunately, with a very tight budget, it's hard to allow the audio department creative freedom. We want to hire a vocalist, live instrumentalists, and voice over artists for the characters, but with the current budget situation, it is not possible. That's where Kickstarter comes in. With your help, we can make Ciel Fledge better by securing much needed funds for the audio department, along with considering your input for the game. Let's make a game we can all enjoy!

Whether the Kickstarter succeed or not, we will still releasing the game, although with a little bit lower quality than we want to make it to be. The game is slated for release at the middle of next year, around June - July 2018.

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Update 1.4 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10715969/f4721860d7f49617d1db59a52abb3a7e0d6a7d38.png[/img]

It's been a while since we released a new major update, and now it's time for another one!

This update mainly add sounds when you step on things, like on the grass, wooden planks, well, anywhere step-able, for your immersion pleasure.

And with this update, we're about to expand the hot springs content. Most of the stuffs are pretty hidden since there are barely any hints to access them. The latest update will have the party members to tell you about it, so they can have fun together!

Here's the summary of the update:
- Several bug fixes.
  * Balance adjustments.
  * Disabled ability to use camp on the sea.
  * Other minor fixes.
- Walking will produce sounds.
- Added extra dialogues in the hot springs.
- Party members may remove their towels in the hot springs when they want to.
- Slight revamp on talk to party member interface (you can now see your relationship status)

Thank you for playing Nusakana, and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.2 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10715969/1f45010f18aadd52e257a17678c9a5ca14682d78.png[/img]

Update 1.2 Hibiscus is here! 

The highlights of this update are:[b][list]
 [*]Fixed the long, lingering heavy lag that have been plagued the game 
 [*]Fixed rare glitch that makes electric cable in the village disappear when the weather is changing
 [*]Fixed missing quest board graphics and fishing store billboard in certain circumstances
 [*]Fixed shadow bug in the Inn
 [*]Added new costumes for Molamola, Gurami, and Auria
 [*]Various fixes and tweaks[/b]

The new costumes are equipment that will change the character appearance completely. To acquire the new costumes, you have to meet certain requirement, mainly affection levels. Here's a guide on how to acquire them:
[olist]
 [*][b][i]Sunny Sundress (Molamola)[/i][/b]: Have Molamola's Affection level to Buddy. An event will trigger at western side of the beach (near tourist quest board).
 [*][b][i]Eastern Uniform (Auria)[/i][/b]: Have Auria's Affection level to Buddy. An event will trigger at the village's farm.
 [*][b][i]Elvan Ancient Armor (Gurami)[/i][/b]: Have Gurami's Affection level to Mate. An event will trigger at her home.[/olist]

[b][u]Screenshots:[/u]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10715969/79751854e54dc2ce347ff0582a28a471fd704790.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10715969/d71198bf6565628f4f4a1e0e6dd5cac9e4cd72a0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Rollback
notes.content:
The recent update that should fix heavy lag from occuring anymore unfortunately trigger unexpected game-breaking bug to surface. We are sorry for the inconvenience, we are looking into this problem and will fix it as soon as possible.

For now the latest update have been rolled back to the previous, while we investigate and fix the bug. Please restart your steam client to download the fix/rollback update automatically.

In case you're wondering, the rolled back version already have the heavy lag fix, so you won't experience any heavy lag in the rolled back version.

Thank you!

Hope you guys enjoy the new update, and have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.11d is here! And regarding the long, rare problem of heavy lag...
notes.content:
The latest update, 1.1d, has been issued to address many bugs and stuffs. Save files will be 100% compatible, of course.

In regards of this long, rare problem of heavy lag, it's found out, many thanks for the testers, especially since this problem is relatively rare. that it's mainly triggered when the game is played normally (via Steam). The heavy lag doesn't occur when played straight from its Game.exe. Playing straight from Game.exe renders the Steam features like the Achievements not functioning, of course. We're still looking into this matter.

More information about the rare heavy lag can be seen here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/401290/discussions/1/412446890549201652/


Hope you guys enjoy the new update, and have fun!

notes.title: [Important] Update 1.1c-a for Beta Testing
notes.content:
Update 1.1c-a is here to do a lag countermeasure in a set interval, mainly several movements between areas. The countermeasure starts when an usual delay from loading between areas happen. 

Since it is unconfirmed if it's 100% stable and/or if the countermeasure does its job, the update is currently available in Betas (Right-click Nusakana in Games Library -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Test). Please do tell if it does work or not. When it's confirmed to work well, it will be updated for the default Beta. 

If the corresponding version isn't stable enough, you can always turn back the version by selecting the Beta to default. There is still a possibility of save file problems when it happens, so please don't hesitate to report any save file problems for us to fix.

Thank you for understanding and for your cooperation.

As promised, major update for Nusakana is live now, if you haven't got the update prompt please restart your steam client!

The spotlight of this major update is the new various game modes with improved and enhanced gameplay to suit both casual and hardcore player.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2rFIRfb.jpg[/img]
[b]4 New game modes[/b]
Easy - For those who prefer to enjoy story with minimal challenge, you can play a more linear and less difficult easy mode.
Normal - With Improved balance and enhanced gameplay, this is the recommended mode for new Nusakana player and veteran alike.
Extreme - Craving more challenge on the island? Permadeath? AUTO-SAVE!? If there's up to your alley, you can now play the game with more hardcore challenge!
Classic - The original Nusakana gameplay. Old save files is categorized in this mode.

[b]More fishing quests![/b]
You may now find more quest involving fishing certain fishes from the village quest board!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qFfgMdj.jpg[/img]
[b]Improved shop and quest interface[/b]
See the stats of those equipment you want to buy at various shop. Also, a vastly improved quest interface now featuring quest difficulty notification and location!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/X7vOpfM.jpg[/img]
[b]Sleep Deprivation (Only available on normal and extreme mode)[/b]
Manage and balance your adventure, now sleeplessness may hamper you. Don't forget to stock up those tent before venturing out into the wilds!

[b]New Achievements![/b]
A whooping total of 55 new achievements have been added to the list! Can you unlock them all? Some of the hint also hint of some secret event you might find!

[b]A better way to capture and upload screenshot[/b]
Refer to the guide here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=579952930

[b]Various bug fixes[/b]
The neverending quest of fixing bugs continues.

Hope you guys enjoy the new update. Have fun!

notes.title: Incoming Major Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's been almost a month after Nusakana release, while the release was not as smooth as we hoped to be, I'm really glad that the some of you find the game enjoyable.

Thanks to the review and feedbacks we have received, even now we are continue to improve the game for your enjoyment. Most of the complaint so far is about how horrible the english is. Actually while we admit that our english is not the best, the horrible english is intentional due to Nusakana's native inability to speak perfect english. So we apologize if it may leave a bad impression to some of you.

Anyway, here's some of the new features and improvement you might expect on the major update:
[list]
[*] Revamped shop menu, now it can show the item stats too instead of only showing description and effect
[*] Add more detail on quest board interface such as more information and difficulty of the quest
[*] 4 new modes - easy, normal, classic, extreme. For those of you who prefer to focus on the story with minimal challenge, you can now play in easy mode. For those who love challenges, we also included extreme mode!
[*] New status effect [Sleep deprivation] on some of the game mode
[*] Add better way to capture and upload screenshot to steam
[*] Add lots of new unlockable achievement
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

The update will come as early as tomorrow, 20th December. Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
New update has been issued to fix several things:
- An unintended Journal glitch has been fixed. It has taken quite a toll for Mysterious Letter.
- Some minor graphical fix.
- Some fixes to the text.
- Fixed some journal entries.
- Fixed Hamune-related stuck, but it still need to be clarified since we can't quite get what actually made it happen in the first place.
- Chance of battle crashing should have been lowered down. Why the crash happened is still to be looked after.
- Have made that most possible crashes to still let the game continue. But those are still bugs, so, it will be very helpful to report what actually was written as the "crash" occurred and let us actually iron out the source of the problem.
- Fixed bug related to a certain support skill.
- Fixed a BGM bug.

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
The newest update has addressed several issues:
- The porter guy's [b]Harvest[/b] has been removed. It shouldn't be there, actually. We're sorry for the confusion :(

- Journal Entry fixed, especially for Mako's questline.

- Fixed some bugs that causes crash. Any save file is still compatible.

- Fixed cutscene bugs.

- Fixed missing character shadows in the battles

- Now it's possible to use [b]F12 to take screenshots[/b] (and won't restart your game)! But just tap it. Hold the button long enough will make the game restart instead.

- For the moment, it's still not possible to capture and upload screenshot directly to the Screenshot tab, but you can always upload screenshots to share with the community by uploading the screenshots from the folder on your computer to the artwork section on the community hub here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/401290/images/

- Trading cards should drop properly now, be sure to collect and craft badge from them for emoticons and wallpapers.

- Steam Overlay (Shift+Tab) still hasn't work yet, part of the problem is the engine we are using is not compatible with the overlay. At the momeont, we are still finding out the best way to implement it and will let you know if it's all ready.
